# t22.4 — Global Deep-Planning Checkpoint Reconstruction

## Summary

Reconstructed the three mandatory global checkpoints for the complete layered-architecture run:

- The canonical **84/84** requirement IDs map to **37/37** global plan items.
- Original deep-plan tasks **T001–T016** preserve their DAG; source-conversion annotations are
  present for T001–T013, while non-conversion tasks T014–T016 are explicitly not applicable.
- All **55** board tasks mapped, including every remediation and re-gate task.
- C-001 through C-005 closure evidence is explicit.
- `AGT-01` and `SKL-01` use the corrected t22.3 **DIRECT-CLOSURE** state.
- The reproducible producer check passes **29/29** structural invariants and resolves **330/330**
  declared repository paths.

This task is the checkpoint **producer**, not its auditor. All three files deliberately retain
`validation.passed: false` and `status: pending-independent-validation`; only t22.5/architect may
change those values after independent verification.

## Deliverables

- [checkpoints/spec-to-plan.yaml](./checkpoints/spec-to-plan.yaml) — explicit 84-row requirement denominator, base/remediation plan mapping, and corrected final states.
- [checkpoints/plan-to-tasks.yaml](./checkpoints/plan-to-tasks.yaml) — 37 plan items, T001–T016, and the complete 55-task execution ledger.
- [checkpoints/tasks-to-impl.yaml](./checkpoints/tasks-to-impl.yaml) — final-file evidence for T001–T016 plus implementation/validation evidence for every execution and remediation task.
- [checkpoints/t22.4-producer-check.rb](./checkpoints/t22.4-producer-check.rb) — deterministic canonical-ID, DAG, inverse-mapping, ledger, status, and repository-path self-check.

## Producer Structural Checks

The producer check reconciles the exact canonical ID set, requirement group cardinalities, all plan
and task inverse mappings, the T001–T016 DAG, source-annotation applicability, board IDs and roles,
the 55-row planning/implementation ledger pair, task-state arithmetic, C-001 through C-005, and all
explicit repository-path fields. It verifies path existence, not the semantic sufficiency of each
referenced artifact. Semantic evidence review remains exclusively with t22.5.

2. verify all declared counts, uniqueness constraints, mappings, and referenced paths;

4. confirm the corrected AGT-01/SKL-01 evidence;
